objective: Test public peptide-HLA model ranking in a second, patient-grouped, individually administered and assayed peptide domain while expanding the same-task model set.

dataset.name: Zhao et al. personalized neoantigen peptide-pulsed dendritic-cell vaccine cohort
dataset.patient_field: Patient ID, forward-filled only within the source worksheet's explicit patient blocks
dataset.endpoint: post-vaccination peptide-specific IFN-gamma ELISPOT fold increase
dataset.positive_rule: ELSPOT ratio >= 2.0, matching the source publication
dataset.interpretive_scope: vaccine-elicited response after peptide-pulsed DC administration, not natural tumor presentation or untreated intrinsic immunogenicity
inclusion: source worksheet S1 row for an administered 8-11mer SNV-derived short peptide
source patient ID recoverable by documented within-block forward fill
finite ELSPOT ratio, mutant peptide and four-digit class-I HLA
exclusion: missing or ambiguous patient, ratio, peptide or HLA identity

predictors.name: DeepImmuno-CNN
predictors.declared_domain: 9-10mer peptides and exact upstream-supported HLA alleles

primary_estimand.patient_denominator: source patients with at least one ELSPOT-positive eligible peptide on pairwise common support
primary_estimand.model_support: pairwise intersection of valid predicted rows for same-task immunogenicity predictors
primary_estimand.comparison: all estimable paired same-task differences; no universal winner claim
primary_estimand.tie_rule: analytic expectation over all permutations at a score-tie boundary

secondary_estimands: IMPROVE 9-10mer common-support sensitivity for the expanded model set

leakage_policy.exact_peptide_hla: exclude the union of known exact training overlaps for each compared pair
leakage_policy.near_sequence: report same-HLA same-length Hamming-distance-one sensitivity when training sequences are available
leakage_policy.unknown_training_data: retain an explicit unknown label; do not infer absence
leakage_policy.deepimmuno: audit against the public upstream training table
leakage_policy.prime_bigmhc: audit against official PRIME2 Table S4 and the published BigMHC immunogenicity construction
leakage_policy.deephlapan: mark unavailable training identities as unknown unless an official manifest is recovered

stopping_rules: Record stable scientific or runtime incompatibility instead of silently patching, fuzzily substituting HLA, or changing the model.
Exclude model-dataset cells for task mismatch, known leakage, unsupported HLA or reproducible runtime failure.
Failure of one new predictor does not invalidate the external-domain extension if at least the two existing same-task predictors run on qualified data.
Do not change this endpoint or primary metric after external predictions are inspected.
